dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: This food street is great. It really captures that urban feel of Chihu Rock.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: You've got to have a proper breakfast to get yourself in the right mood for work.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Also — if you keep an ear open when you're at one of these roadside eateries, you can usually pick up a few useful snippets of information...
